product_overview: Buon Appetito is a luxury waterfront Italian restaurant website for Port d'Andratx, designed to showcase the brand story, digital menus, wine list, and an interactive table reservation experience. It also includes a private admin backoffice for managing menu content and availability.
core_goals: Explore the restaurant brand story and dining experience
Browse the digital food menu with multilingual support and dietary filters
Browse the wine and beverage cellar with tasting and pairing details
Book a table by selecting party size, date, seating preference, and contact details
Manage menu items and availability through the private admin backoffice

features.name: Landing Page & Brand Experience
features.description: Presents the restaurant story, signature dishes, reviews, location, and clear paths to the menu and reservation experience.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll through the restaurant story and featured sections -> View the interactive circular gallery -> Review customer testimonials and location details -> Choose to view the menu or reserve a table
Navigate to / -> Open the reservation path from the homepage -> Arrive at the booking experience

features.name: Digital Food Menu with Multilingual Support & Filters
features.description: Lets users explore the food menu by category, switch languages, inspect dish details, and start a reservation from the menu.
user_flows: Navigate to /carta -> Switch between menu categories -> Inspect dish details and dietary indicators -> Change the menu language -> Continue to the reservation flow from the menu
Navigate to /carta -> Filter the menu using allergen and dietary preferences -> Review matching dishes -> Return to the homepage

features.name: Wine & Beverage Cellar
features.description: Shows the restaurant’s wine and beverage selection with origins, grape varieties, tasting notes, and language options.
user_flows: Navigate to /vinos -> Browse wine and beverage sections -> Inspect tasting notes, grape origins, and pairing suggestions -> Switch the language -> Return to the homepage or proceed to reservations
Navigate to /vinos -> Move through the cellar selections -> Review the curated drink list -> Start a reservation from the wine page

features.name: Interactive Table Booking Engine
features.description: Guides diners through a multi-step reservation process including party size, date, seating preference, service turn, and contact details.
user_flows: Navigate to /reservar -> Select party size -> Select a reservation date -> Choose seating preference -> Choose lunch or dinner service and a time slot -> Enter contact details and special requests -> Submit the reservation -> See the booking confirmation and summary

Navigate to /reservar -> Switch the reservation language -> Select party size -> Select a reservation date -> Choose seating preference -> Enter valid contact details -> Submit the reservation -> See the confirmation message
Navigate to /reservar -> Enter an invalid name or email format -> See inline validation feedback -> Correct the details -> Submit the reservation -> See the booking confirmation

features.name: Admin Menu Management & Dish Editor
features.description: Provides a private backoffice for authenticated staff to manage food, drinks, wine cellar items, pricing, availability, and translations.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Authenticate with admin credentials -> Switch between menu tabs -> Search or filter items -> Open an existing item or start a new one -> Update title, description, price, category, and availability -> Save the changes -> See the updated menu state

Navigate to /admin -> Authenticate with admin credentials -> Switch between menu tabs -> Open an item editor -> Trigger automatic translation into other languages -> Save the translated content -> See the updated multilingual entry
Navigate to /admin -> Authenticate with admin credentials -> Review operational metrics and audit logs -> Inspect recent content changes -> Return to the menu management view

routes.description: Homepage featuring restaurant story, signature wood-fired pizzas, circular interactive gallery, reviews, and reservation CTA
Interactive digital menu showcasing antipasti, wood-fired pizzas, homemade pasta, carne, desserts, and allergen filters with i18n
Wine and beverage cellar menu featuring local Mallorca wines, prestigious Italian DOC/DOCG wines, spritz, and cocktails
Multi-step interactive table booking engine (guests, date calendar, shift/time slot, contact details, confirmation)
Private Backoffice Administration PWA for live menu management (Food, Drinks, Wine Cellar, Pricing, Availability, AI Translation, Audit Logs)
Alternative menu navigation and redirect view
Legal notice and company registration details
Privacy policy and data protection terms
Cookie policy and tracking consent disclosure

features.name: Admin Menu Management & Dish Editor
features.description: Admin backoffice for managing dishes, drinks, wines, stock availability, pricing updates, and multilingual AI translation
user_interactions: Authenticate with admin email and password or use persistent session
Switch between 3 menu tabs (Comida, Bebidas, Bodega)
Filter items by category chips or live search input
Open Add Dish modal or click existing dish card to edit
Fill dish title, description, price, category, and availability toggle
Click Save in Carta button to persist changes to InsForge backend
Trigger auto-translation into English and German
Access operational KPIs, audit logs with timestamp, and PWA installation guide

features.name: Interactive Table Booking Engine
features.description: Step-by-step table reservation with real-time slot selection, party size picker, calendar date picker, and contact validation
user_interactions: Select party size / number of guests (1 to 10+ persons)
Select reservation date from interactive calendar
Choose dining zone / seating preference (Terraza or Sala interior)
Choose lunch (Almuerzo) or dinner (Cena) service turn and exact time slot
Fill in personal contact details (Full Name, Phone number, Email address, Special requests/allergies)
Submit reservation form and receive visual confirmation with booking summary
Switch reservation language between Spanish, English, and German

features.name: Digital Food Menu with Multilingual Support & Filter
features.description: Comprehensive menu categorized by Starters, Pizzas, Fresh Pastas, Meat dishes, and Desserts with pricing and dietary notes
user_interactions: Navigate between menu categories (Antipasti, Pizze Tradizionali, Speciali, Pasta, Carne, Dolci)
Filter or toggle dish details and allergens
Switch language between Spanish (ES), English (EN), and German (DE)
Click reservation CTA buttons to proceed to /reservar
Click return button to go back to homepage

features.name: Bodega & Wine Cellar List
features.description: Curated selection of Italian and Mallorcan wines categorized by whites, reds, rosés, cavas, and champagne with tasting notes
user_interactions: Browse wine sections (Vinos Blancos, Vinos Tintos, Rosados, Espumosos, Cócteles y Aperitivos)
Inspect grape varieties, origins, and pairing notes
Switch wine list language (ES / EN / DE)
Navigate back to homepage or jump to reservations

features.name: Landing Page & Brand Experience
features.description: Port d'Andratx waterfront restaurant presentation with dynamic hero, wood-fired oven showcase, culinary philosophy, and interactive circular gallery
user_interactions: Scroll through interactive restaurant sections
Interact with 3D/WebGL circular gallery showing food and ambiance
Click Book a Table CTAs directing to reservation engine
View Google Reviews testimonials and Port d'Andratx location map

known_limitations.issue: Hidden required category select breaks mobile/PWA form submission
known_limitations.impact: Unable to add new dishes or edit existing dishes in mobile Safari and PWA mode due to unhandled select options
